ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast between the dominant low-intensity (black) pigmentation and localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, with an approximate macro-level ratio of 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-grey to black pigmentation mapped across the visible fluke surfaces; high-contrast white circular geometric blobs are concentrated along the distal trailing edge and the lateral outer periphery of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the medial axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular sawtooth pattern along the continuous linear boundary; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 25 pixels in depth, particularly on the distal margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a broad convex sweep transitioning to a fractured, jagged distal terminus; the right lobe presents a narrow, linear trajectory from this perspective.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized along the peripheral margins and the posterior-medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged irregularities and apparent tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy accumulation of white calcified-type circular protrusions along the peripheral boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in visible lobe morphology, with the left lobe exhibiting a significantly larger visible surface area and more complex edge topography than the right lobe.
